SEARCH BUDGET: the shared WebSearch budget for this run was exhausted after 14 searches, before targeted searches for facilities, accessibility, dining/retail, hotels and the MyRapid timetable could be run. Those topics are gaps, not negatives.
Official terminal opening hours (only an unofficial '24 hours' statement from a hotel listing was found; AIP AD 2.3 not captured).
Official terminal layout: level names, number of gates, check-in counter rows, self check-in kiosks, self bag-drop, immigration autogates and eligibility.
Airport-wide check-in guidance (recommended arrival time, counter closing times); only Cathay Pacific's check-in window was sourced.

Facilities - nothing sourced in this run: prayer room locations, nursing/baby-care rooms, clinic or first aid, left luggage (existence, location, hours, rates), Wi-Fi details, ATM/bank and money changer locations, SIM/telco counters, post office, smoking areas, showers, charging points, lost and found.

Accessibility services - nothing sourced: wheelchair assistance and how to book, accessible toilets, reserved parking bays, lifts, hidden-disability support (e.g. whether MAHB's Butterfly Effect programme operates at Penang), assistance for visually or hearing impaired passengers.
Dining and retail outlets - no confirmed outlet names, locations or opening hours were sourced.
Hotels at or near the airport - not researched (search budget).

Full current airline list and destination list from an official source; the names of the 6 domestic cities; status of specific carriers (e.g. Firefly, Batik Air Malaysia, flydubai, IndiGo, HK Express, Starlux) not confirmed. Route start dates from travel-trade sites are low confidence.

Ranking among Malaysian airports - sources conflict (one calls Penang third busiest by passengers, another second busiest in 2024); official MAHB statistics tables for 2024 and 2025 were not obtained. 2025 growth rate conflicts across sources (11.25%, 8.4%, 7.97%).
Runway length and width (designator 04/22 confirmed; dimensions not returned by search).

Rapid Penang: location of the airport bus stop, official first/last bus times from the airport, the exact fare airport - Komtar / Weld Quay, payment methods on board (cash exact fare vs Touch 'n Go / card), and whether an 'AT' airport transit route or any night service currently operates.
Taxi: official coupon tariff by zone, counter location and hours, night surcharge rules, number of passengers per taxi, limousine options. Third-party fares conflict.
E-hailing: official walking route and door number to the pick-up zone, drop-off rules at the departures kerb, any e-hailing surcharge.
Car rental: names of companies with counters, counter opening hours.

Parking: official confirmation of the standard tariff and its effective date; payment methods (third-party guides variously describe cashless payment by Touch 'n Go card, Visa, Mastercard and MyDebit, and pay-at-machine with ticket - source not attributable); valet parking (an aggregator lists RM10 first hour, RM5 per following hour, RM70 per day - source not attributable); grace period; motorcycle parking; lost-ticket fee; current number of bays; open-air versus multi-storey areas; EV charging; accessible bays.
Contact: airport-specific passenger enquiry number and email, lost and found contact, airport police. The eAIP number (+604-252 0252) conflicts with an older number (+604-643 4411).

Expansion: WP03 contractor and award date, terminal construction start date, final terminal floor area, phasing of in-terminal works, and specific 2026 passenger impacts and temporary arrangements (temporary check-in or gates, bussing to remote or temporary stands, kerb or lane closures, car park changes). Only the new e-hailing zone and the airside supplements were found.
Expansion cost conflict: RM1.55 billion (MAHB, July 2025) versus RM1.2 billion (The Vibes headline, October 2025).
Runway closure schedule (hours and days) under the CAAM supplement in force since 28 November 2024.
Bridge and ferry practicalities: toll amounts, ferry fares and timetable, drive times to the mainland; Penang LRT Mutiara Line plans for an airport station and timeline.
Distance to George Town: 16 km (third-party) versus 14 km from KOMTAR (AIP) - road distance and typical drive time need an agreed figure.
